differences.a_observable: The 'Subscriptions' card at the top of the frame is heavily blurred due to shallow depth of field.
differences.b_observable: The 'Subscriptions' card at the top of the frame is in sharp focus.
differences.fix: Enable camera depth of field and adjust the focus distance to keep only the middle card sharp.

differences.a_observable: The corners of the frame show a distinct dark vignette.
differences.b_observable: The corners of the frame are evenly lit with no vignette.
differences.fix: Apply a vignette effect to darken the corners of the frame.

differences.a_observable: The shadow underneath the yellow Recurly card is deep and dark, creating strong contrast.
differences.b_observable: The shadow underneath the yellow Recurly card is very light and faint.
differences.fix: Increase the shadow intensity or ambient occlusion under the yellow card to improve contrast.

differences.a_observable: The yellow Recurly card has a warm, saturated golden hue.
differences.b_observable: The yellow Recurly card has a cooler, less saturated greenish-yellow hue.
differences.fix: Adjust the material color of the Recurly card to be warmer and more saturated.

json.highest_impact_fix: Enable camera depth of field with a wider aperture to match the professional focus falloff on the cards.
